briefing.summary: Pre-flight at a regional aerodrome where ATIS isn't broadcast. Need to request it from Information.

challenge.prompt: Request the current aerodrome information from Bankstown Information.
challenge.expectedText: Bankstown Information, Lima Echo Foxtrot, request aerodrome information.

elements.label: Request
elements.hint: Use the phrase 'aerodrome information' — 'ATIS' is the broadcast service name; the controller readout is the underlying information.

challenge.explanation: AIP GEN 3.4: at aerodromes without an ATIS broadcast, request the aerodrome information from the appropriate Information unit (ground or tower) before taxi.

refs.note: Source/access date 2026-06-09. Aerodrome information request format.
